notes.title: Master the Forge
notes.content:
Greetings adventurers,

Journey deep into the heart of Nangrim and unravel the mysteries that have been tucked away within its ancient tunnels. Introducing, for the very first time, the concepts behind the resource cycle and forging mechanic that promises to challenge both your crafting skills and survival instincts!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/77658adc317c18b0cd4b296d8a6ad9628dc8a5c6.jpg[/img]

[h1]From Rust to Relic[/h1]
Whether you stumble upon a rusty pickaxe or embark on a quest to locate the perfect ore, the depths of Nangrim will offer a plethora of materials. Smelt these ores into pristine metal ingots and be prepared to forge them into instruments of unparalleled power. 🪓 

[h1]The Forge's Fervor[/h1]
The essence of forging is not just in the metal, but in the heat. Each material demands a specific fervor; a heat so intense that you may need to venture into the treacherous forests for wood, or dive even deeper into the mountain's belly for coal. ⛏️🔥 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/542829456852ba1b802734c4684663bd144acbfb.jpg[/img]

[h1]Master the Craft[/h1]
But be wary! Tools deteriorate, especially under the punishing work of a dedicated dwarf. As you integrate more and more materials into your forging processes, the complexity of the crafting recipe increases. Not just skill, but artistry and precision are required. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/cccdfa8232a51bbc355bd0e50302fd5e37520e76.jpg[/img]

Forge illustrious hammers, pickaxes, and a myriad of other tools. Hone your forging abilities and imbibe the expertise passed down from generations. ⚒️⛏️

[previewyoutube=t_dJQnEYZwk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Crafting Melody – Hear the Echoes of the Mountain[/h1]
Feel the resonance of the mountain with each hammer blow on the anvil. The metals have their song, their rhythm, and as a master blacksmith, you'll learn to play along. 

The dwarven crafting melody is a symphony that resounds deep within the heart of the mountain, where the art of metallurgy takes on a mystical form. Every clang of the hammer against metal isn't just a mere strike but a note, forming a unique song that speaks to the essence of each item being crafted. As the smith's hammer falls, it taps into the very rhythm of the mountain itself, echoing ancient beats that have pulsed through the earth for aeons. The anvil and hammer serve as instruments that amplify this rhythm, allowing the crafter to tune into each melody and mold the metal in harmony. The result is a piece that isn’t just a tool or weapon, but a manifestation of the mountain's song and the legacy of the ancestral spirits. Each crafted piece, be it a blade, armor, or trinket, carries with it a distinct song, a testament to the skill and spiritual connection of the hands who forged it.

[spoiler]Technically, the number of blows and their intensities at the different anvil positions define the forging melody, which corresponds to a numerical hash. This hash defines the procedural appearance of the forged item (tool, weapon, jewellery, tankard, etc.).  If you change the melody, the shape changes in tandem.[/spoiler]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/3ae862b567f8e14807725282ea4a111b5f9d0908.jpg[/img]

Also, you might unearth crafting techniques from various dwarven clans and perhaps even integrate the wisdom of other races or dark cults.

[h1]The Legend of Haldyr[/h1]
Among the dozens of metals, legends whisper of Haldyr – the most sacred and sturdy of metals. To forge with it, one needs a flame hotter than any conventional furnace can provide. Rumors abound of dragon fires with the potential to melt even Haldyr. Will you be the dwarf to find them?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/968cd0ea1ae7b00708617cdde7d3ebb202a84e85.jpg[/img]

[h1]Final Words[/h1]

In the unforgiving realm of Nangrim, challenges abound. Tools and weapons deteriorate, and demand repair. But resources are a rare treasure, demanding effort to extract from the mountain's firm embrace. Your robust arms, while powerful, drain energy, necessitating ample food and brews. But, even brewing beer requires more than mere air and sunlight. 🍺🐝🌞🌬️

Get ready to delve into advanced production chains and cyclical resource systems. As you progress, the complexity will amplify, demanding strategic planning, efficient management, and a keen understanding of the interconnected processes.

Reclaiming the mountain won't be a stroll in the park, but then again, when have dwarves ever backed down from adversity? The mightier the foe, the sharper the axe!

Join us on the development journey of "Return to Nangrim", merge survival with craft, and let destiny guide your hammer. See you in the mines; the tunnels are waiting. ⛏️

notes.title: Stonebeard's Calendar
notes.content:
The world-building in "Return to Nangrim" is not merely about the rich lore, the intricately designed locations, or the challenging environment. It's also about the subtle details that breathe life into the game, such as the ever-changing seasons, the lifelike climate of Ebboria, and the deeply rooted traditions of its former inhabitants, the Stonebeard Dwarves.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/4db4749bc77f20ae58b14a279e873b798dc09177.jpg[/img]

[h2]The Seasons of the Stonebeards: A Cyclical Dance of Rock & Snow[/h2]

Unlike their northern cousins, who dwell deep within the mountains, Stonebeard Dwarves live both above and beneath the earth. This unique lifestyle necessitates a keen understanding of the seasons, which significantly impact their farming and famed brewing industry.

[h3]Garsòrandìr (Late Winter or 'Spring'):[/h3]
Begins with the ceremonial Day of Stone. Ebboria slowly emerges from its icy slumber, and the snow recedes to reveal the stone beneath. An ideal time for sowing and preparing the fields.

[h3]Hilgùrson (High Sun or Summer):[/h3]
As the sun casts its golden embrace upon Ebboria, the dwarves reap the rewards of their hard work. This season is characterized by jubilation, dancing, and many a toast raised with freshly brewed ale.

[h3]Frimsòrandìr (Early Winter):[/h3]
Marked by the Day of Snow, the first snowfall ushers in a sense of urgency among the dwarves. The hillside farmers, in particular, scurry to harvest the last of their crops.

[h3]Sòrandìr (Deep Winter):[/h3]
A true test of resilience. The winds are merciless, the cold unforgiving. Yet, in this harsh climate, the brewing masters work their magic, preparing for the next cycle of growth.

[h3]Ahatòr Stòrdargan (Time of Mud):[/h3]
Experienced both during spring and autumn, this transitional season represents renewal, growth, and change.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/702c099ca4169b6f2c34fdfd2b6902b73c35d5e2.jpg[/img]

[h2]Navigating the Dwarven Calendar: Month by Month[/h2]

The northern dwarves segment their years into twelve moon periods. While the seasons dictate the broader rhythm of life in Ebboria, the dwarven months add layers of depth to their traditions.

[b]Vonatòr[/b]
In the heart of Ebboria, as the first snow melts, Vonatòr emerges as a beacon of hope. Dwarven clans unite, their songs echoing promises of renewal and brighter tomorrows.

[b]Harkatòr[/b]
By the glow of flickering flames, elders regale tales of valor and ancient lore. It's a month where the young listen, eyes wide, and the past melds seamlessly with the present.

[b]Werfandor Arkasìn & Werfandor[/b]
The mountainside is awash with color as flora awakens. Craftsmen find inspiration, and every corner of Ebboria seems touched by a masterful dwarven painter's brush.

[b]Berandir[/b]
A sacred time where anvil strikes are rhythmical, akin to heartbeats. New artifacts are born, symbolizing the endless cycle of creation within the heart of the dwarven halls.

[b]Hisarìn Trilogy (Arkasìn, Hohìdòr, Sìrdoran)[/b]
The sun, though mild, shines the brightest. It's a dance from dawn's gentle embrace to the zenith of midday, finally bowing to dusk's lullaby. Festivals abound, celebrating the sun's embrace and the fruits of labor.

[b]Fallandìr Lifamìr[/b]
Leaves turn golden, mirroring the storied halls of the dwarves. It's a month of reflection, of cherishing moments and preparing for the eventual embrace of Frimsòrandìr.

[b]Tavaltòr & Frimsantòr[/b]
The air turns crisper, and preparations begin. Granaries are stocked, and ales are brewed stronger, ensuring warmth in the impending chill.

[b]Dorgantòr[/b]
The mountain's embrace becomes firmest now. Dwarves retreat to the deeper halls, seeking solace in their ancient chambers, rejuvenating for the cycle to begin anew.

[h2]Impacting Gameplay: Calendar Meets Craft[/h2]

In "Return to Nangrim", we've ensured an accurate simulation of Ebboria's climate, intertwined with the dwarven calendar. This doesn't just serve an aesthetic purpose. Your in-game actions, from sowing to crafting, are directly influenced by the seasons, moon phases, and sun cycles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/2da474e23d34444bb1c200513e9e1b77721f37b0.jpg[/img]

For instance, crafting during certain moon phases might result in a sturdier axe, while brewing during the Hilgùrson might produce a more robust ale. This dynamic system encourages players to strategize, making choices based on the environment. 🏔️💎

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/8dfbc39bfaf5faaae60b5dee35ca62016788e3be.jpg[/img]

[h1]Final Words[/h1]

We've put heart and soul into these details, ensuring that every season, every month adds depth to your gameplay experience. Get ready for an unparalleled journey, where the calendar and climate isn't just a backdrop; it's an integral part of the story. As the dwarven calendar progresses, players will witness and experience palpable changes in the environment. The intricate dance of the seasons brings with it tangible shifts in the very fabric of Nangrim's atmosphere.

Players will experience dynamic meteorological changes, from the enveloping embrace of fog to the gentle cascade of snow. And just as the climate changes, so does the bounty of the land and beneath it. When you pluck an apple or delicately gather berries, timing is paramount; harvested at the season's zenith, these fruits offer unparalleled wholesomeness. Similarly, the treasures buried deep within the mountains, the gleaming ores and hidden gems, resonate with the calendar's rhythm. The very heart of the mountain pulsates in tandem with the time of year, bestowing its richest rewards on those who understand its cyclical song. ⛏️🍻

We hope this provides a good starting point for showcasing the rich seasonal lore and its gameplay implications in "Return to Nangrim".

notes.title: Mountain Tales won't affect the game's timeline
notes.content:
We have noticed that some concerns have been raised regarding the potential impact of the [url=https://www.backerkit.com/call_to_action/13f15ca7-0844-49f0-ab01-cb96dcb970fe/landing]"Mountain Tales"[/url] comic on the timeline of the "Return to Nangrim" game. We would like to take this opportunity to clarify a few important points.

Firstly, the game and the comic are being developed completely independently of each other. This means that the progress and development of the game will not be affected by the creation of the comic.

Furthermore, it's important to note that the comic is intricately connected to the world of the game. It serves as a valuable resource, providing connections, knowledge, and even content that can be utilized within the game. The story of the comic unfolds before the events of the game, creating a cohesive and interconnected experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/3b477262d9499dbacd4de10d501bc45dfc661df1.jpg[/img]
By exploring the Mountain Tales comic, you will uncover valuable information that directly applies to the gameplay and storyline of "Return to Nangrim." It enhances your understanding of the game world and its ruleset and enriches your overall gaming experience. So, for instance, if you learn about a legendary soup recipe in the comic, chances are good that you are able to replicate this in the game.

[previewyoutube=hcdmd8s60rU;full][/previewyoutube]

We hope this clarification alleviates any concerns and reinforces the exciting and interconnected nature of the "Mountain Tales" comic and the "Return to Nangrim" game.

Thank you for your support! 🏔️🍻⚒️🤘💎

Greetings adventurers, to another Feature Reveal!

When you are lost in the abandoned mountain city of Nangrim or can't find your way back to known terrain in the depth of the mines you can rely on your dwarven ancestry in form of a

notes.content:

[h1]LIGHT TORCHES[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/0679c4c07b700a861aad35bc90e35a5a3e81106a.png[/img]

As you cross the threshold the stone gate slams shut. The darkness surrounds you and your eyes try to adjust, however, every light source is suffocated at that moment. You hesitate at first, but then decide that it is your only choice to take your torch out, and set it alight. Unsure of the danger you might be putting yourself in, as the torchlight will draw great attention and might put you right in the enemy's sight, you set your torch alight. The warm light of the fire not only relieves your eyes from painfully trying to identify something in the dark but also you recognize more torches fixed to the walls. As you enkindle these, you feel your fear ebb and the tiniest spark of hope begins to glow.

[h2]What is the Players Guild?[/h2]
We want to let a wide variety of players from both sides of the spectrum of our target audience (from puzzle dwarves to RPG slasher from the PC Masterrace) test and evaluate mechanics: democratizing the development of a game to some extent. notes.content:
Greetings adventurers!

The first member announcements for the player's guild have been sent out, and here's already a little special for those who made it into that 'illustrious circle' of component testers! 

We've received a letter from the royal consultant [i]Bèrebon [/i](you'll find the letter at the bottom) and he seemed a little worried and nervous. Apparently, they are desperately searching for a [b]master blacksmith[/b] - maybe it is one of you? 

The [b]first [/b]person that can prove he has forged what Bèrebon is looking for wins one of our[b] limited exclusive dwarven T-Shirts[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/a736a91d999930a7dee30b9bab03b01e6deddfa5.jpg[/img]

These are the rules:

[list]
[*]Puzzle together the clues

[*]Make a Screenshot of the forged result
[*]Send the Screenshot to hello[at]sycoforge.com, together with your full name and adress
[*]Receive our T-Shirt
[*]Wear our fancy T-Shirt!
[/list]

We will keep you updated as soon as we have a winner!

 Haven't made it into the player's guild? Don't worry! 

You [b]have [/b]already applied: you will automatically participate in the selection process for the second component test. 

You [b]haven't [/b]applied yet:  join our [url=https://discord.gg/XY7BQDNzqA]discord [/url]and claim the 'Player's Guild Aspirant' role as soon as the application round for the second component test gets announced.

 In the meantime: may the best blacksmith win and good luck!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/c204ce8b35a732986698fa344bfcb8f4612619c9.png[/img]

Hyr Frinbard!
A lonesome warrior came wandering our kingdom. His garments filthy and he half dead of thirst. He said the Nimbor mountains he had to climb - foolish he is with the equipment that he has! Nay real dwarf would ever try such a daring undertaking with a cankered axe like his and boots worn out, allowing the cold to move in. Sending him off I would have, but gracious as the heart of our king is, he advised us to accommodate him and prepare equipment for his departure. Argoran already made his deliciously famous Frìnsentìn Pie, and Belastrian delivered boots of finest fur and cheveril glove from Eshgard, but how should he be supposed to climb with just a lousy axe?! Assigned by the king was Haldòr to forge him the Snowbeards' famous axe, that with its light 6kg 500g is perfectly made for that purpose, but, how should it be: the drunkard has already passed out in the Tavern... sigh... Why is Bordjal even getting served in the morning?! Either way, a [b]master blacksmith[/b] is wanted to forge the Snowbeards' axe for our visitor! Unfortunately, the exact recipe is not known, and asking Haldòr - well, allow to say that this is not an option. One says that its head is [i]15 and a quarter times[/i] heavier than its [i]wooden [/i]handle, but what does someone like me know! It is up to a master blacksmith that the honor of the king might not get tarnished! Here is to see a visual representation of said axe:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/7a95c1cff59df8e5303f558c9dbf23aaec9e144d.jpg[/img]

May their craft speak for those who are willing to forge this weapon! And rest assured, their work shall be rewarded! Oh, and forget not the special [i]alloy [/i]needed for this weapon, two in number I've heard! If it be true only I'd recall the name... Either way: don't use the expensive iron or wood!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/c204ce8b35a732986698fa344bfcb8f4612619c9.png[/img]

notes.title: Feature Reveal Part 13 - Combine

Greetings adventurers, to another Feature Reveal!

The ingenious mind of a dwarf knows not only how to craft and mine, but also how to

[h1]COMBINE[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/f740e1e1328e6396020330f41d0b34fa7423b312.png[/img]

A dwarf loves nothing more than swinging the hammer to craft a practical tool, or deadly weapon. However, a forge is not always near, and when navigating the cool darkness of the mountain, tools and weapons are of essence. The dwarve's natural gift of craftsmanship and an ingenious mind shall allow you to precede where others have failed and will let you realize how meaningful combining what seemed useless fragments or single resources can be for your journey.

notes.title: Feature Reveal Part 12 - Inspect
notes.content:
Greetings adventurers, to another Feature Reveal!

As you progress through the mountain system you will gather many items, some more, some less familiar. Also, you will find information in books, on old parchments, and otherwise. This will allow you to understand what was previously uncommon, wherefore you are well-advised to

[h1]INSPECT[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/ba9800869f2582b1fc29f617eb9abecee06d24c7.png[/img]

your inventory every once in a while.

That was close! While gathering your spoils from the latest enemy encounter you hear hundreds of legs sprinting towards you. You snatch up the last coin, retrace your steps to distance yourself from the approaching noise, take a side path, and just master to quietly shut the door. As a horde - the footsteps unknown to your ears - rushes past. Now, in the dim light of your torch, you take the time to inspect your loot. Amongst it, you find a mysterious object, a long handle made from wood covered with scratches all over. However, the top and the base are neatly decorated with metal and now that you look at it closer it resembles a lever of some sort. Maybe there is a part missing to make it a whole? You decide to leave it in your inventory, for now, sure that once you've found the right information, it will be of more value than you attribute it at the moment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/57e2da7e1b305f646cfff0071e4261d584543df6.png[/img]

notes.title: Feature Reveal Part 11 - Explore
notes.content:
Greetings adventurers, to another Feature Reveal!

Whether it be wondrous phenomena of nature or a mechanical switch which you are considering to trigger, be sure to...

[h1]EXPLORE[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/62297de948969d29aa1e622d94537e179931b531.png[/img]

As a matter of survival, and when not [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/860210/announcements/detail/2110440927177052311]running [/url]from some monstrous beast, it is wise to explore first and act second. It is a skill of utmost importance when you find yourself alone in a desolate and mysterious place. Take the time and you shall find essential objects for your quest, or perhaps you will reveal which door better to leave sealed. It is advisable to explore as much as you can to help yourself find a way forward. Also, examining how other venturers before you have been killed might just save you from their fate.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/301ef8da0abe1e9fe89890391c1a19a0eed86f6b.png[/img]

notes.title: Feature Reveal Part 10 - Play Instrument
notes.content:
Greetings adventurers, to another Feature Reveal!

When [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/860210/view/3958066754930547447]singing [/url]you will have to admit that a dwarf's voice might be powerful and resounding, however, not the most harmonic. Therefore, the dwarves have long been taught to 

[h1]PLAY INSTRUMENTS[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/4c476b44d43ad14973b286ba3b63df114f3e65ae.png[/img]

And a strong voice shall be accompanied by something rhythmic, whether it be the sole drumming of a dwarf‘s fingers on the ax or the play of an instrument. As you endorse in song and play you start remembering more songs. When alone what better way to find some comfort by playing on your newly found instrument, especially if it helps your memory, and who knows what else a dwarf is capable of doing with an instrument.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/82d90f24cae87fc141c5012c3d166da242134e91.png[/img]

notes.title: Feature Reveal Part 9 - Sing
notes.content:
Greetings adventurers, to another Feature Reveal!

Almost as much as drinking and mining a dwarf loves to:

[h1]SING[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/23d7d53f7ab86fd1ef64dd6cbc4ab613c74b2b53.png[/img]

When the spoken word is not enough to express relief, happiness or pride - or when just drunk - a dwarf will turn to song. Whether songs of war or tales of glory, some have been sung for so long even the stone walls remember the lyrics. However, the powerful resounding voice of a dwarf may carry far into the mountain, so beware, and check the alleys and the darker corners, not to make creatures of the dark aware of your presence.

notes.title: Feature Reveal Part 8 - Talk
notes.content:
Greetings adventurers, to another Feature Reveal!

More useful than you might expect, an important feature will be:

[h1]TALK[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/a923a82976c0c42a06e4e7943e86c0691541c55b.png[/img]

Exploring dark and narrow spaces for a length of time and alone, leaves a trace even in the most sturdy brain. The intense inspection of the environment and constant tension due to possible danger, lets some strange thoughts flourish. Thoughts that - without realizing it - form into words that then unwillingly cross the lips. Before long you might find yourself talking to yourself. notes.title: Feature Reveal Part 7 - Throw stone
notes.content:
Greetings adventurers, to another Feature Reveal!

A fairly weak attack, but possibly your most strategic move might be to:

[h1]THROW STONE[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/a48ab725c190b8b5bbef3ce98d371e24d869352f.png[/img]

Your heavy two-handed ax, one of the most terrifying weapons when wielded skillfully diminishes in impressiveness as you compare it to the jaws of the monstrous creature in your path. Even though you are sure about the path you’ve chosen you must admit to yourself that you are not ready to take on this thing. In despair, you turn around, but as you do so a small stone in front of you catches your sight. You pick it up and it feels smooth and cool in your palm. Standing there you consider if the monster reacts to sound and if you might be able to mislead it. Well, giving it a try won’t harm .. unless .. you hit the beast! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/860210/view/2110440927177052310]RUN[/url]!

notes.title: Feature Reveal Part 6 - Destroy
notes.content:
Greetings adventurers, to another Feature Reveal!

Whether you are trying to unveil a hidden object from inside a crate or need to take a barrel apart for firewood. A useful ability will be to:

[h1]DESTROY[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/5038f3d420c626f855af86dd9007a2b120e0fb06.png[/img]

You lift up a wooden box standing in your way and are about to toss it to the side as you realize something jingling on the inside. As you shake the box you recognize the sound as something small and metallic - might be something which could come to good use. In an attempt to break the wooden box you thrust it to the ground but it won't break. Instead of giving it a second try you grab your axe, lift it high and force it down smashing the wooden box. Fragments fly in all directions and you shoulder your axe once more. As you kneel down to closely examine the contents of the wooden box it unveils just what you had been looking for. Your journey may continue.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/960e986c23b4c0aae6d4942071228262fdb988ac.png[/img]

For more updates, news, videos and discussions follow our [url=https://discord.gg/aWGXAcr]Discord[/url].

notes.title: Feature Reveal Part 5 - Inflame
notes.content:
Greetings adventurers, to another Feature Reveal!

As you will be wandering in dark cold dungeons you also should be able to:

[h1]INFLAME[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/42bc3caa61a1c49b87ff77e6fb34027662242f07.png[/img]

The room you enter is cold and spacious. There are only rocks and the remains of barrels and crates lying around. It seems you have found what was once a storage room. You are tired, and this place offers the perfect space to get some rest as it is secluded and shielded off against possible enemies. If only it wasn’t for the cold. But with ingenuity, you collect the remains of the barrels and crates and set them alight with your torch. You have kindled a warming and illuminating fire.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/5d5eec2c9745dea34c21bc2591389cd569009b46.png[/img]

notes.title: Feature Reveal Part 4 - Block
notes.content:
Greetings adventurers, to another Feature Reveal!

Last time you've learned that one of your skills is attacking, so logically you also should be able to:

[h1]Block[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/0740da1893c00718e19dc8761a577159ca4f3bd8.png[/img]

You have already heard the grumble of the giant troll as you’ve entered the abandoned jail, now it is time to face him in the mines. Prepared as you are, you hit him first strike, yet his enormous size and power still grants him advantage. But, even the boldest dwarf does not wade into battle without a repertoire of blocking skills, and the longer the battle, the more the odds turn to your side.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/a9641d1c1235fbac33b37a2a2ab033061c0fcd24.png[/img]

notes.title: Feature Reveal Part 3 - Attacking
notes.content:
Greetings adventurers, to another Feature Reveal!

While some games successfully manage to refrain from using any physical confrontation, surviving in an abandoned dwarven fortress needs the ability to:

[h1]ATTACK[/h1] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/36bcf2c3267057846ab79ad62b95cb030bea1198.png[/img]

The sun has almost risen. You have managed to get a few hardly needed hours of sleep after spending the whole day walking around long corridors trying to find your way through this abandoned place.

You wake up by the sound of a cracking tree branch not too far away from you. As you are quickly hiding behind a misty rock, waiting with your heavy dwarven ax steady in your hands, you take a peek where the noise came from and see a big furry creature coming towards you. 'It must be a bear', you think, as you prepare for a fight as the creature approaches sniffing the air around him. As the beast comes out of the shadow, you realize that this 'bear' is rather an eight-legged monster with a furry back.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/77258e89fac846aae0349b7bbd2705be4f7a258b.png[/img]

notes.title: Feature Reveal Part 2 - Running
notes.content:
Greetings adventurers, to another Feature Reveal!

As the last Feature Reveal was [i]walking[/i] the logical 'upgrade' to this is:

[h1]RUNNING[/h1] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/959bc4f69a1e781d5f885dba8ae8595c6297a336.png[/img]

You hear a creaking sound coming from behind you. It could be anything, you think - a rat, the wind, or debris that has come off the mountain. But that would be too obvious, and as you turn around, you spot a giant creature with one too many legs crawling in the shadows. Without anything but your own hands to defend yourself, you decide it would be better to run away this time.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/a099b06efd6bd2df74f44d02c2790a1749aecb17.png[/img]
